20	/**
21	 * Builds an owner's {@code customerCode}, formatted {@code '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'} where
22	 * LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
23	 * global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
24	 */
25	@Component
26	public class CustomerCodeGenerator {
27	
28	    private static final int PREFIX_LENGTH = 3;
29	
30	    /**
31	     * Build the customer code for a new owner.
32	     *
33	     * @param lastName           the owner's last name
34	     * @param existingOwnerCount the number of owners already registered; the assigned
35	     *                           sequence is one more than this value
36	     * @return the formatted customer code, e.g. {@code "SMI-0007"}
37	     */
38	    public String generate(String lastName, long existingOwnerCount) {
39	        String prefix = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(PREFIX_LENGTH, lastName.length())).toUpperCase();
40	        return String.format("%s-%04d", prefix, existingOwnerCount + 1);
41	    }
42	}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. It is normalized to E.164 form:
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the
            result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered with the clinic. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. When true, the create endpoint
            skips the duplicate-household check that otherwise rejects a new
            owner sharing another owner's last name and address.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0001'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that deliberately share a
                household, i.e. the same last name and address. Assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set true and an existing
                owner already occupies that household; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-0A1B2C3D4E5F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's
                first and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented `membershipNumber` assignment for owners, formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>` where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year.

Since a membership number is purely a function of two fields the owner already carries (`customerCode` and `registrationDate`), I modeled it as a derived, read-only property rather than a stored column — mirroring how the codebase already handles `initials` (`@Transient` getter on `Person`). This keeps it seed-independent and always consistent with its source fields, and sidesteps an ordering bug: `registrationDate` is defaulted late, in `@PrePersist`, so computing/storing it during `saveOwner` could see a null date.

Changes:
- **`Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient getMembershipNumber()` that formats `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, returning null until both source fields are present. The formatting logic lives on the domain object next to its other derived accessors.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the `membershipNumber` read-only property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct auto-maps it from the getter (no mapper changes needed).

No DB migration, generator, or service wiring was required. `AcceptanceTest.coreMembershipNumberFormat` and the full build pass.
